target:
NARRATIVE: A star number is a centered figurate number that represents a centered hexagram (six-pointed star), such as the one a child may make with sticks. The nth star number can be calculated using the formula: 6n(n-1) + 1. This formula comes from the pattern of adding layers of points around a central point to form a star shape.

ACTION: {"expression":"6*n*(n-1) + 1"}
